text_copy.text: The AC Power Adapter (ACPA) is intended for use with the LIFEPAK 15 (LP15) monitor/defibrillator. The power adapter consists of an AC power adapter, AC power cord, and power adapter output cable. An optional output extension cable is available.

text.text:
Product issue

Stryker has identified an increase in number of complaints related to LP15 ACPA failures with the reported symptoms of “Battery Not Charging” and “Auxiliary Power Will Not Power Device or Charge Batteries”. This issue is only applicable to ACPAs used on 110V power grids.

 

Is your product is affected?

Please review the following to identify if your product is part of this notice and complete the necessary steps.

  1. Are you located in a 110V power grid?
  2. If you answered yes to Question 1, do your devices have a manufacturing date between 11/3/2021 – 04/24/2023?
  3. Of the devices for which you answered yes to question 2, are your devices missing the black dot as noted in the picture below? 
  4. Of the devices for which you answered yes to question 3, are your devices listed on the Serial Numbers Affected?
